FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Precision Builders Group specializes in residential construction, focusing on new home builds and interior renovations for single-family homes. Our operations prioritize safety and compliance, ensuring that all projects adhere to local building codes and regulations, except for work in high-risk areas such as New York City, Nassau, Suffolk, and Westchester counties. We employ licensed subcontractors for specialized trades like electrical and plumbing work, with an emphasis on maintaining a clean safety record and effective risk management practices. Our annual payroll remains under $1M, and we limit subcontracted work to no more than 30% of total project costs. All tools and equipment are securely stored when not in use, and we carry the necessary insurance coverage to protect both our business and our clients.

Our company specializes in residential and commercial construction projects, including renovations and new builds, in various areas, such as New York City and its surrounding counties like Nassau, Suffolk, and Westchester.
